name: Fi'lang
description: Featuring a curved blade, the fi'lang was the traditional combat knife of the reptilian Trogodile species. In 22 BBY the Trogodile Swyy'm-Ee wielded a pair of fi'langs during a gladiatorial match in the Cauldron, a fighting arena on the planet Rattatak. However, Swyy'm-Ee was killed midway through the match by the Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress.
